title: Chat SDK bot for Slack, Telegram, and the web
description: A Vercel Chat SDK bot that answers on Slack, Telegram, and useChat, streams replies from AI Gateway, and keeps conversations, subscriptions, and locks in Neon Postgres.

environment.name: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN
environment.description: For /slack: the Bot User OAuth Token (xoxb-...) from your Slack app's OAuth & Permissions page. If you didn't scaffold /slack, delete this key from neon.ts.

environment.name: SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET
environment.description: For /slack: the Signing Secret from your Slack app's Basic Information page; verifies that requests come from Slack. If you didn't scaffold /slack, delete this key from neon.ts.

environment.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
environment.description: For /telegram: the bot token from @BotFather. If you didn't scaffold /telegram, delete this key from neon.ts.

environment.name: TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET_TOKEN
environment.description: For /telegram: a random secret (letters, digits, _ and -, for example from openssl rand -hex 32) you also pass to setWebhook; verifies that requests come from Telegram. If you didn't scaffold /telegram, delete this key from neon.ts.

environment.name: CHAT_WEB_TOKEN
environment.description: For /web: a random token (at least 32 characters, for example from openssl rand -hex 32) your backend sends as Authorization: Bearer <token>; required because Neon Function URLs are public. If you didn't scaffold /web, delete this key from neon.ts.

operations.title: Slack bot
operations.description: Slack's Events API and interactivity URL: answers @mentions and DMs, follows the threads it was mentioned in, and streams replies with Slack's native streaming.

operations.title: Web chat for useChat
operations.description: POST the body useChat sends, with a bearer token and an X-User-Id header, to stream a reply in the AI SDK UI message format; earlier turns are read from Postgres.

operations.title: Telegram bot
operations.description: Telegram webhook: answers private chats and group mentions, verified with the webhook secret token; chat history is kept in Postgres.
